baseline.production_warning: Live-state claims older than the cutoff must be reverified; repository presence is not proof of deployment.

status_definitions.built_repository: Implementation and automated source evidence are on main; live deployment and role smoke may still be required.
status_definitions.partial: Some implementation exists, but an identified user-visible or verification slice remains.
status_definitions.in_review: A PR exists outside main and must be reviewed, fixed and merged before deployment.
status_definitions.verification_required: Repository implementation exists, but the last production audit found drift or no current live proof exists.
status_definitions.gated: Implementation depends on an explicit business, legal, accounting or architecture ruling.
status_definitions.missing: No implementation evidence was found for the scoped outcome.
